home.heroLead:
Kansai-style eel, grilled over charcoal until fragrant.
A lunchtime-only eel restaurant, 5 minutes from Nagoya Station.
home.introBody: Kansai-style eel is grilled without steaming, so you taste the fragrance of the charcoal and the full flavor of the eel. Enjoy it over rice with our sauce.
home.menuLead: Unadon and hitsumabushi. Choose how much eel and how much rice you would like.
home.hitsuBody: As it is, with condiments, then with tea broth. Three flavors from a single bowl.
home.reserveBody: We take table reservations by phone. Please feel free to call us.
home.dinnerBody: In the same place, we open in the evening as 和牛すき焼きしゃぶしゃぶSakura 名古屋店, serving Omi beef and Kuroge Wagyu courses.
home.snsBody: News and freshly grilled eel, straight from our kitchen.
home.galleryLead: Step through our cherry-blossom entrance to private rooms and sunken kotatsu seating. Groups are welcome.
home.videoAlt: From plain grilling to sauce and charcoal finishing

guide.title: How to eat hitsumabushi
guide.lead: One bowl, three ways to enjoy it. Find your favorite.

steps.title: First, as it is
steps.body: Scoop some into your small bowl and enjoy the charcoal-grilled eel and sauce-seasoned rice just as they are.

steps.title: Add condiments
steps.body: Top with shredded nori, wasabi and green onions for a fresh, fragrant flavor.

steps.title: Pour over tea broth
steps.body: Add condiments, pour over the tea broth and enjoy it lightly, like ochazuke.

guide.tip: Finish with whichever way you liked best.
guide.kansaiBody: Kansai-style eel is grilled without steaming, so you can really taste the fragrance of the charcoal and the richness of the eel.
guide.unadonBody: Fragrant eel over sauce-seasoned rice, simply served, with soup and pickled Chinese cabbage.
guide.videoNote: Dividing the bowl into four, serving, adding condiments, then pouring tea broth (about 28 seconds, no sound).

access.title: Access
access.lead: A 5-minute walk from the Sakura-dori (East) Exit of Nagoya Station, on the 4th floor of Yanagibashi Food Market.
access.mapAlt: Map from Nagoya Station to 炭火うなぎSakura
access.floorNote: In the evening, the same place opens as 和牛すき焼きしゃぶしゃぶSakura 名古屋店. Look for the 和牛 sign on the map.
directions: Leave Nagoya Station by the Sakura-dori (East) Exit.
Using the map, walk past Midland Square to Nishiki-dori street (about 5 minutes).
Enter the Yanagibashi Food Market building and take the elevator to the 4th floor.
access.taxiNote: Show this address to your driver.
photos: Look for our sign on the ground floor
access.videoNote: From the Sakura-dori side of Nagoya Station to our entrance (about 36 seconds, no sound).

reserve.title: Reservations
reserve.lead: We take reservations by phone. Please tell us the date, time and number of people.

items.a: We are open every day, 11:00–14:30 (last entry 14:00).

5 minutes on foot from the Sakura-dori (East) Exit of Nagoya Station, on the 4th floor of Yanagibashi Food Market. Please take the elevator. In the evening, the same place opens as 和牛すき焼きしゃぶしゃぶSakura 名古屋店.

items.q: Do you have menus in other languages?
items.a: Yes, we have menus in English, Chinese (Simplified) and Korean.

items.q: Can I choose the amount of rice?
items.a: Unadon comes with 250 g of rice (350 g +¥100, 450 g +¥200). Hitsumabushi comes with 300 g (400 g +¥100).
Enjoy it three ways: as it is, with condiments, then with tea broth. See our “How to eat hitsumabushi” page for details.
